basis: Carcinoma arises in thyroid C cells; nodal spread adds no axis, and distant organ involvement is occasional.

Dystroglycanopathies primarily cause muscular dystrophy; brain and eye involvement varies across subtypes and is not established as common across the umbrella.
Calcium deposition affects renal parenchyma; underlying metabolic disorders are causes rather than required components.
Inherited retinal degeneration, a subtype of retinitis pigmentosa.
Defined by disordered glucose metabolism; no additional organ damage applies across most subtypes.
Alcohol directly causes hepatic inflammation and injury; this is not an autoimmune or infectious hepatitis.
Global developmental delay is frequent; other structural organ abnormalities are occasional, and hypotonia alone does not establish muscle disease.
Inherited red-cell aplasia; thenar hypoplasia in 7/10 supports musculoskeletal involvement. Cardiac, renal and ocular defects are uncommon.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability occur in all assessed patients; small hands and high palate alone do not establish additional organ damage.
Human infections in this group predominantly involve intestinal roundworms; anemia and pulmonary disease are not universal across the umbrella.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing impairment, reported in 3/3 patients.
Neonatal diabetes and macroglossia define syndrome; cardiac defects annotated 80-99%. Neonatal seizures and respiratory distress do not establish lasting injury.
Cholesterol defect, intellectual disability and diagnostic limb anomalies; dental malformations 80-99% support GI involvement. Cardiac and eyelid defects omitted by cap.
Congenital unilateral duplication and triphalangeal malformation of the thumb.
Congenital remnant of the fetal bladder-to-umbilicus connection; infection is a possible complication rather than intrinsic mechanism.
Skeletal sclerosis, cutis laxa and intellectual disability define syndrome; choanal atresia annotated 80-99%. Common enamel hypoplasia omitted by cap.
Benign epididymal cyst confined to the male reproductive system.
An acid-base disorder; renal and pulmonary causes do not establish those organs as affected across the umbrella.
Mature B-cell lymphoma, predominantly nodal; extranodal organ involvement is explicitly infrequent.
Localized cutaneous amyloid deposition with persistent pigmentary changes and dry skin in 9/9; systemic amyloid disease is not implied.
Severe neurodevelopmental impairment, limb skeletal defects and GI malformations define syndrome; genitourinary sites are unspecified and infections are secondary episodes.
Congenital infection with defining CNS and hepatic disease; chorioretinitis is a major diagnostic feature. Hearing injury varies by pathogen and is omitted by cap.
Congenital postaxial duplication of a formed digit; no syndromic organ involvement is established.
Localized mucin deposition produces cutaneous nodules; the name does not imply thyroid disease or systemic involvement.
